title: Polygenic architecture of brain structure and function, behaviors, and psychopathologies in children
summaryPoints: Maps genome-wide polygenic influences onto brain structure and function in the ABCD developmental cohort.
Identifies gene-brain convergence patterns linking polygenic scores to cortical and subcortical phenotypes.
Characterizes pathways from polygenic risk through brain phenotypes to behaviors and psychopathologies.
significance: Demonstrates population-scale genomic-connectome convergence as a foundation for computational psychiatry.
labRelevance: Flagship Connectome Lab publication in Nature Communications.
